Policies

Terms and conditions

Last updated 24 October 2026

1. About these terms

These terms are an agreement between Magizh NexGen Technologies, 3/501, Subash Street, Muneeswarar Nagar, Iyer Bungalow, Madurai - 625014, Tamil Nadu, India (“we”, “us”), and the business that subscribes to iSuite AI (“you”). By creating an account, paying for a plan or using iSuite AI, you agree to them. If you accept them for a company, you confirm that you may do so on its behalf.

2. The service

iSuite AI is software we provide online, at app.isuite.ai and in the iSuite AI Android app. Depending on your plan it includes a shared inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and web chat, an AI agent, customer records, quotes and invoices, payment links, calling from your own phone, broadcasts, automations, bookings, forms and reports. We improve iSuite AI over time; we will not take away a feature your paid plan includes during a period you have paid for without telling you first.

3. Your account

  • Give us accurate details and keep them up to date.
  • You are responsible for the people you add to your account and for what they do in it.
  • Keep logins safe, and tell us at once if you think someone has used your account without permission.
  • iSuite AI is for business use by adults (18 and over).

4. Plans and payment

  • Prices are in Indian rupees. GST is added to every invoice.
  • Plans are paid in advance, monthly or yearly, through Razorpay.
  • A package can start with a free trial. You approve auto-debit when the trial starts, and the first payment is taken when it ends unless you cancel before then.
  • If you turn on automatic payment, your plan renews at the end of each period until you cancel.
  • An upgrade starts at once and the difference is charged; a downgrade takes effect at your next renewal.
  • If a payment fails, we remind you. If it is still unpaid after the grace period, your account may become read-only until it is paid. If it stays unpaid, the plan may be cancelled and its data later deleted, as the privacy policy describes.
  • We tell you at least 30 days before a price change applies to your next renewal.
  • The AI agent runs on iSuite AI credits. A plan with the AI agent includes credits, and you can buy more; bought credits are billed by us, with GST.

5. Charges from others

Some costs are billed by other companies, not by us:

  • WhatsApp message charges, billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account.
  • AI usage on your own AI keys, only where we have agreed that your company uses them, billed by that AI provider (for example OpenAI, Anthropic or Sarvam).
  • Calls made from your phone, under your own mobile plan.

Meta’s WhatsApp Business, Commerce and Messenger policies apply to messages you send through iSuite AI, and Meta decides on approvals and limits for your WhatsApp number.

6. Acceptable use

You agree not to use iSuite AI to:

  • send messages to people who have not agreed to hear from you, or send spam;
  • sell illegal goods or services, mislead people, or impersonate anyone;
  • harass, threaten or abuse anyone;
  • break the law, including laws on data protection, consumer protection and call recording;
  • try to break into, overload, copy or resell iSuite AI without our written agreement.

Where the law requires it, you are responsible for telling customers that calls may be recorded and for getting their consent.

7. Your data

The customers, conversations, deals and files you keep in iSuite AI belong to you. We store and process them only to provide the service, as our privacy policy explains. You can export your data while your account is active. When you leave, your data is deleted as the privacy policy describes; tax invoices are kept as the law requires.

8. AI features

The AI agent writes replies from the information you give it. Like any AI, it can make mistakes. You are responsible for the information you give it and for checking replies that matter, and you can switch the AI off at any time. We do not promise any particular number of sales or result.

9. Availability and support

We work to keep iSuite AI running at all times, but it may be interrupted for maintenance, or by problems outside our control, such as an outage at Meta, a cloud provider or an internet service. We help on WhatsApp and by email.

10. Cancellation and refunds

You can cancel at any time. Our refund and cancellation policy explains what happens to your plan and your payments.

11. Suspension and ending the service

We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, does not pay, or that we must suspend by law or because Meta requires it. Where we can, we tell you first and give you time to fix the problem. You may stop using iSuite AI at any time.

12. Liability

As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses such as lost profits, lost sales or lost business, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

13. Our software and name

iSuite AI, its software and its name belong to MnT Future. Your subscription gives you the right to use iSuite AI while it is active. If you send us suggestions, we may use them to improve iSuite AI.

14. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. We post the new version here with its date, and tell you about important changes by email or in the app before they apply.

15. Law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes are subject to the courts at Madurai, Tamil Nadu. Before going to court, please write to us — most problems can be solved quickly.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.rawHtml:
Policies

Privacy policy

Last updated 18 October 2026

Who we are

iSuite AI is business software, made for each industry, by Magizh NexGen Technologies, 3/501, Subash Street, Muneeswarar Nagar, Iyer Bungalow, Madurai - 625014, Tamil Nadu, India (“we”). Businesses use it to talk to their customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and website chat, to keep their leads, deals, bookings and follow-ups, and to call customers from their staff’s own phones. This policy covers this website (isuite.ai), the web app (app.isuite.ai) and the iSuite AI Android app.

This website

  • This website has no forms, sets no cookies and uses no analytics or advertising trackers.
  • It loads its fonts from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address and browser details to deliver them.
  • If you contact us on WhatsApp, by phone or by email, we use your name, number, email and message to answer you and to talk to you about iSuite AI. WhatsApp messages pass through Meta.

Your account, and your company’s data

  • Your account. When your company gives you a login, we keep your name, email address, phone number if you add one, photo if you add one, your role and your settings. Your password is stored only as a secure hash.
  • Your company’s records. The customers, messages, notes, deals, bookings, files and call records your company keeps in iSuite AI belong to your company. It decides what goes in and who may see it; we store and process them for your company, to provide the service.

What the app collects and why

  • Messages and customers in your company’s inbox: names, phone numbers, usernames, message text, photos, voice notes and files, to send and receive your company’s conversations.
  • Call history (Android app, only after you turn on “Use this phone for calls”): the number, date, time and length of a call and whether it was answered, only for numbers already in your company’s records. Other calls are skipped and never leave your phone.
  • Call recordings (Android app, only if your phone records calls and you allow it): the recording of a call with a customer in your company’s records, attached to that customer.
  • Microphone: only while you record a voice note to send.
  • Camera, photos and files: only the ones you choose to send or upload.
  • Notifications: a device token from Google Firebase, so new messages and tasks can reach your phone. It is removed when you sign out.
  • Security and usage records: sign-in times, IP address, device and browser type, and logs, to keep the service safe and working.
  • AI features: if your company turns on the AI agent, the messages in its conversations are sent to the AI provider your company connects, to write replies.
  • Payments: plan payments are handled by Razorpay; we do not store card or bank details.

We do not sell personal data, we do not show ads, and the app does not use the advertising ID.

Who processes data for us

  • Amazon Web Services: our servers and backups, in India (Mumbai, with backups in Hyderabad), and email delivery.
  • Meta Platforms: the WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger messages your company sends and receives.
  • Google: Firebase Cloud Messaging for phone notifications, and Google Fonts for this website.
  • The AI provider your company connects, if any.
  • Razorpay: payments.

Each uses the data only to provide its part of the service.

How long data is kept

  • Your account: while you have a login. When it is deleted, your login and profile go; records you made for your company stay with your company.
  • Company data: while the company uses iSuite AI. When a company leaves and is deleted, its data is deleted. Tax invoices are kept as the law requires.
  • Backups: daily copies are kept 31 days and monthly copies about a year, then deleted automatically, so deleted data leaves the backups as they expire.
  • Messages you send us about iSuite AI: as long as we need them to answer you and keep our records.

Security

Data travels encrypted (HTTPS) and is stored on encrypted disks and in encrypted backups. Passwords are never stored in plain text, and channel tokens and API keys are stored encrypted. Inside a company, what each person can see follows the roles its admin sets.

Your choices and rights

  • See and correct your profile in the app, under Settings → Your profile.
  • Delete your account or some of your data: in the app, Settings → Login & security → Delete my account, or on the account deletion page.
  • Turn off call history, recordings or notifications at any time in the Android app or your phone’s settings.
  • Under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can ask us for a copy of your personal data, to correct it or to erase it, and you can raise a complaint with us. For the data your company keeps about you, you can also ask that company.

Children

iSuite AI is a business tool for adults. It is not meant for anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect children’s data.

Changes

We update this page when iSuite AI changes; the date at the top shows the latest version.

Contact

Questions or complaints about privacy:

Magizh NexGen Technologies, 3/501, Subash Street, Muneeswarar Nagar, Iyer Bungalow, Madurai - 625014, Tamil Nadu, India

refund-policy.title: Refund and cancellation policy
refund-policy.rawHtml:
Policies

Refund and cancellation policy

Last updated 24 October 2026

In short: you can cancel at any time and keep using iSuite AI until the end of the period you have paid for. Payments are not refunded once a plan period has started.

Free trial

When you start a free trial on a package, you approve auto-debit with Razorpay, and the first payment is taken only when the trial ends. Cancel before it ends and you pay nothing. Once the first paid period has started, the rules below apply.

Cancelling

  • Tell us on WhatsApp or by email, any time before your next renewal.
  • Your plan stays active until the end of the period you have paid for. After that, nothing more is charged.
  • If automatic payment is on, we stop it for the next renewal. You can also cancel the auto-debit in your UPI app or with your bank.
  • When the plan ends, your workspace stays read-only for a while so you can export your data, and is then deleted as our privacy policy describes.

Refunds

Once a plan period has started — monthly or yearly — its payment is not refunded, including for days, users or features you did not use. Add-ons and packs are not refunded once bought, and setup or onboarding fees are not refunded once the work has started.

A downgrade takes effect at your next renewal; the current period is not partly refunded.

When we do refund

  • You were charged twice for the same thing.
  • You were charged for a renewal after cancelling before the renewal date.
  • We took a payment but could not activate your plan within 3 working days.

Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 5–7 working days of our confirmation. Your bank may take a few more days to show it.

Charges billed by others

WhatsApp message charges are billed by Meta, and AI usage on your own AI keys (only where we have agreed to it) by that AI provider. We cannot refund them; their own policies apply.

How to ask

Write to info@mntfuture.com or message us on WhatsApp (+91 82209 47112) with your company name and the payment ID or invoice number. We reply within 2 working days.

data-deletion.title: User data deletion instructions
data-deletion.rawHtml:
Policies

User data deletion instructions

Last updated 16 October 2026

About iSuite AI

iSuite AI is a business growth platform developed by Magizh NexGen Technologies. It helps businesses manage customer relationships, Facebook Lead Ads, advertising workflows, Instagram integrations, and customer conversations through connected Meta services.

How to request data deletion

Users can request the deletion of personal data associated with their iSuite AI account and connected Meta services.

To request deletion:

  1. Log in to your iSuite AI account at app.isuite.ai.
  2. If you are using a test account for evaluation, use the test-account credentials provided to you separately.
  3. Contact our support team through the official contact details published on isuite.ai.
  4. Request deletion of your iSuite AI account data and specify any connected Facebook, Instagram, or other Meta-related data you want deleted.
  5. We will verify the request and process the deletion of applicable data in accordance with our data deletion procedures and applicable requirements.

Please do not send passwords, access tokens, or other secret credentials when submitting a deletion request.

What data may be deleted?

Depending on your request and the services you have used, deletion may include:

  • Customer and lead information received through Facebook Lead Ads.
  • Data associated with connected Facebook Pages and Instagram professional accounts.
  • Relevant customer conversation and integration data.
  • Stored Meta access tokens and connection information associated with the relevant account.
  • Other personal data associated with your iSuite AI account, where applicable.

Disconnecting a Meta account

Disconnecting Facebook or Instagram from iSuite AI stops the relevant integration from being used. Disconnecting an account does not necessarily delete previously stored data. To request deletion of previously stored data, please submit a data deletion request using the process above.

Inactive accounts and deletion requests

For inactive subscriptions, data may be retained for up to 60 days after the subscription becomes inactive, in accordance with our retention policy.

A valid data deletion request is handled separately from the inactive-subscription retention period. We will process applicable deletion requests without undue delay, subject to legal obligations and any applicable retention requirements.

Test account information

Meta reviewers may use the test account provided separately to evaluate iSuite AI’s features. The test account is intended for app review and does not change the data deletion rights or procedures described on this page.

Contact us

For data deletion requests or questions about personal data, please visit:

  • Website: isuite.ai
  • Privacy policy: isuite.ai/privacy
  • Support: Use the official support contact published on our website.

Magizh NexGen Technologies is responsible for handling applicable data deletion requests for iSuite AI.

Magizh NexGen Technologies, 3/501, Subash Street, Muneeswarar Nagar, Iyer Bungalow, Madurai - 625014, Tamil Nadu, India
